promotedRootSource: docs/architecture/DRIVE_TOPOLOGY.md: E:\ArkStation\augments is the home for Omnitek Augment items that live outside the repo (extensions precedent, 2026-10-11). Not a SolaTree worktree.
contract: rows are @ark/lexicon omnitekItemSchema fields (type, subtype, composition, origin, tier, actions) plus item metadata; kind is the host sub-kind under subtype extension; archetype is from augmentArchetypeSchema
classification: Ruled from AGENTS.md canon on 2026-10-15: Omniwand.exe is an Augment, atomic subtype Component, the native Windows surface of the Wand capability. Its Logi plugin is a separate Augment, subtype Extension. Neither is a Mod (no agent consumes it through Ark) nor a Machina (it hosts no Host or Automaton work).
canonRulings: Operator ruling 2026-10-15 (Justin): keep the Omniwand name and re-admit it in canon as the label of the Windows Wand Component. The earlier superseded rows in ARK_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_BLUEPRINT.md and ARK_CORE_TAXONOMY_AND_PROGRESSION.md and the drizzle 0022 ops-row migration (component:omniwand to component:wand) are historical. Canon term `omniwand` (parent component, surface of wand) is being added by the registration PR.
kindsNote: desktop-extension is the existing lexicon Extension sub-kind for desktop host applications (ruled 2026-10-14); Logi Options+ is such a host, so no new sub-kind is added.
